question: Which TMC candidate won the Asansol (West Bengal) by-poll election in April 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Shatrughan Sinha**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **TMC or All India Trinamool Congress is a political party from West Bengal and Mamata Banerjee is the Chairperson of the party.**

 
 
• She was the former Minister of Railways.
 
 
 
• ​In 1998, she separated from the Indian National Congress (INC) and started her own party which is ruling West Bengal since 2011.
 
• **Shatrughan Sinha is an actor turned politician who is currently serving as a Member of Parliament, Lok Sabha from the Asansol Constituency from TMC. Hence option 3 is correct.**
 
• He earlier served as a Member of Parliament, Lok Sabha from Patna and a Member of Parliament, Rajya Sabha during 1996-2002.
 
• **Sinha was also a Minister of Health and Family Welfare under the Atal Bihari Bajpayee government.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mamata Banerjee is the current Chief Minister of West Bengal since 2011** and the Chairperson of the TMC party.

 
 
• **She served as a Minister of Railways twice and became the first woman to serve twice.**
 
 
 
• **Agnimitra Paul** is a fashion designer turned politician who is currently serving as a **Member of Legislative Assembly from Asansol, West Bengal** since 2021.
 
• **Rahul Gandhi is a Member of Parliament, Lok Sabha from the Wayanad constituency, Kerala** and is the former president of the Indian National Congress (INC).
 
 
• ​​He is the chairperson of the Indian National Youth Congress.
 
• The current president of INC is Mallikharjun Kharge.
 
 

bc:T
